Package org.aristonis.diwan.database.pgsql

Class PostgresQueryGrammar

java.lang.Object
org.aristonis.diwan.database.query.QueryGrammar
org.aristonis.diwan.database.pgsql.PostgresQueryGrammar
public class PostgresQueryGrammar extends QueryGrammar
Compiles queries into PostgreSQL SQL, a hand port of Laravel's Illuminate\Database\Query\Grammars\PostgresGrammar.

Differences from the base grammar: like compares the column as text, date wheres use casts and extract, insertGetId uses returning, an insert that ignores errors uses on conflict do nothing, an update or delete with joins or a limit goes through a ctid subselect, and truncate restarts the identity.

Laravel's operators that hold a ? (the JSON operators ?, ?|, ?& and @?) are left out, because JSON wheres are not supported; so are its bitwise-only operators. Truncate never cascades: Laravel cascades by default, which also empties every table that references this one.

Instances are immutable and safe to share between threads.

    • compileUpdate

      public String compileUpdate(Builder query, Map<String,?> values)
      Compiles an update of the rows the query's conditions match.
      Overrides:
      compileUpdate in class QueryGrammar
      Parameters:
      query - the query, never null, with a table
      values - the columns and their new values, never null or empty; an Expression is written as given, a Builder as (select ...)
      Returns:
      the SQL, never null
      Implementation Note:
      With joins or a limit, the rows to change are picked by a ctid subselect, which keeps the query's joins, wheres, orders and limit. Its bindings (join, then where, then order) follow the set values, the order prepareBindingsForUpdate gives. The subselect is compiled from a copy, so query is not changed.

    • compileUpdateWithJoins

      protected String compileUpdateWithJoins(Builder query, String table, String columns, String where)
      Compiles an update of a query with joins. Laravel's base grammar writes update t inner join ... set ..., which neither SQLite nor PostgreSQL accept, and which would need the join bindings before the set values; here the base grammar refuses it and a database grammar rewrites the query, keeping the order of QueryGrammar.prepareBindingsForUpdate(org.aristonis.diwan.database.query.Builder, java.util.Map<java.lang.String, ?>): set values, then join, then where.
      Parameters:
      query - the query, never null
      table - the wrapped table, never null
      columns - the compiled set list, never null
      where - the compiled where clause, never null, may be empty
      Returns:
      the SQL, never null
      Throws:
      UnsupportedOperationException - always, in the base grammar
